explanation: The two-job execution contains an upstream fault. The stipulated corpus includes n06-r01 with demand_score 9, so it qualifies under the score-threshold selection criteria and should be preserved in both the needs and evidence_sources handoffs. Job 1 output silently omits n06-r01, and Job 2 then correctly preserves and processes the seven records it received. The visible function evidence localizes the omission to normalize, whose allowed_record_ids list excludes n06-r01 and includes n06-r09 instead, causing retained_df to filter out the qualifying top-ranked record before downstream handoff.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus contains {'record_id':'n06-r01','demand_score':9,'need':'isolate faulty execution branches before replay','source_id':'s01','source_weight':5}.
Behavioural criteria require selecting all qualifying or fallback demand records and preserving record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
job_1 output needs and evidence_sources start at n06-r02 and contain only 7 records; n06-r01 is absent.
normalize source defines allowed_record_ids = ['n06-r09','n06-r02','n06-r03','n06-r04','n06-r05','n06-r06','n06-r07','n06-r08'] and filters retained_df by isin(allowed_record_ids).
job_2 input exactly matches the faulty seven-record handoffs from job_1, and job_2 output preserves those seven records.
